title: Loka
text: Kismiṃ loko samuppanno || kismiṃ kubbati santhavaṃ || kissā loko upādāya || kismiṃ loko vihaññatīti || || Chasu loko samuppanno || chasu kubbati santhavaṃ || channam eva upādāya || chasu loko vihaññatīti || || Addha-vaggo sattamo || || Tass-uddānam || || Nāmam Cittaṃ ca Taṇhā ca || Saṃyojanaṃ ca Bandhanā || Abbhāhat-Uḍḍito Pihito || Icchā Lokena te dasā ti || || ___________________________________________ CHAPTER VIII. CHETVĀ-VAGGO. Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
